aboutGame.title: What is Warhammer Survivors?
paragraphs: Warhammer Survivors is a grimdark bullet-heaven action roguelite set in the Warhammer universes. You pick a hero, drop into a hostile map, and fight off escalating waves of enemies while your weapons fire automatically, so staying alive comes down to movement, positioning, and the build you assemble.

Every run is a race between your damage and the horde. Collect experience, choose upgrades at each level, and evolve maxed weapons by pairing them with the right passive before claiming the evolved form from an elite or boss reward. Runs are short and repeatable, and meta progression carries permanent power into every new attempt.

modules.name: Warhammer Survivors Beginner Guide
modules.description: A step-by-step Warhammer Survivors beginner guide covering movement, experience flow, build choices, and the mistakes that end runs early.

highlights.detail: Keep moving and circle the horde instead of standing still to fight
Sweep back through your kill zone so you never leave experience on the ground
Treat every level-up as a build decision and commit to two or three damage sources
Take at least one mobility or pickup-range upgrade to keep leveling
Max a carry weapon early and hold its linked passive for an evolution
Spend meta rewards between runs to raise your permanent baseline

faq.title: Warhammer Survivors FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Warhammer Survivors.

items.question: What is Warhammer Survivors?
items.answer: Warhammer Survivors is a grimdark bullet-heaven action roguelite set in the Warhammer universes. You pick a hero, fight off escalating enemy waves with auto-firing weapons, and build up upgrades until your loadout can clear the screen.

items.question: How do you survive longer in Warhammer Survivors?
items.answer: Movement comes first. Warhammer Survivors rewards circling the horde and keeping a clear escape lane far more than standing still to fight, and your damage comes from the build you assemble between level-ups.

items.question: How do weapon evolutions work in Warhammer Survivors?
items.answer: Most Warhammer Survivors evolutions need a base weapon at maximum level plus its linked passive, then a reward drop from a boss or elite to trigger the evolved form.

items.question: What is the best build for beginners in Warhammer Survivors?
items.answer: Start with a rapid-fire primary weapon, add one area-clearing secondary, and take move speed plus pickup range early. A forgiving Warhammer Survivors build like this teaches positioning without punishing small mistakes.

items.question: Does Warhammer Survivors have co-op?
items.answer: Yes. Warhammer Survivors supports squad play with shared or split experience and revives that keep the run going, so role balance matters as much as raw damage.
